pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/LiveWarRoom.tsx:55 The context is a client dashboard that renders scan history, a leaderboard and a ship-loop poll snapshot; it composes no hook chain around model or tool calls, loads no contributed code and holds no conversation checkpoints, and a recursive search of src/features/inflight/live and src/app/org/[slug]/live (and all of src) found no registerHook, loadPlugin, wrapToolCall or parentRunId (the only 'hook' hits are React hooks and a useShipLoop comment).

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:263 The context indexes a registry repository's skills/practices/memory into mirror rows and renders an onboarding view; it reports skill invoke counts but never assembles or runs an agent loop, so no hook placement, code-loading tier or checkpoint custody exists here, and searching src/lib/org, src/features/shared/registry and the registry routes (and all of src) found no registerHook, loadPlugin, wrapToolCall, parentRunId or toolCall.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/lib/integrations/otlp.ts:3 The context receives OTLP metrics and logs exported by an external agent (Claude Code) and folds them into usage records; it observes another runtime's telemetry and assembles no runtime of its own, and searching src/lib/integrations, src/app/api/integrations, src/lib/db and the integrations page (and all of src) found no registerHook, loadPlugin, wrapToolCall, parentRunId or tool_use.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/billing/webhook/route.ts:2 The context is checkout, webhook fulfilment and plan-tier routes for Polar billing, with no agent loop, hook chain, contributed extension or durable conversation state, and a search of all of src (which covers src/lib, src/app/api/billing, src/app/api/org/plan, src/app/pricing and src/features/admin/settings) found no registerHook, loadPlugin, wrapToolCall or parentRunId.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
